description: Returns a normalized booking handoff link for a source-linked Orange County, CA barbershop; it never creates or confirms an appointment. Use when: the user has selected a barbershop and wants its official booking or contact handoff for a service and, optionally, an appointment date. Do not use when: the user needs WhichAgent to create or confirm an appointment, take payment, guarantee a live slot or price, find beauty categories beyond barbershops, or serve locations outside Orange County.

appointment_date.description: Optional desired appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

business_id.description: Required stable business ID returned by search.

service.description: Optional published service requested, such as haircut or beard trim.

name: book
title: Get Barbershop Booking Handoff
